mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dp_base.t_dp_base_process_template(process_code, process_name, owned_enterprise_code, table_code, process_info, set_operation_flag, process_state, over_started, remark) VALUES (#{processTemplate.processCode}, #{processTemplate.processName}, #{processTemplate.ownedEnterpriseCode}, #{processTemplate.tableCode}, #{processTemplate.processInfo}, #{processTemplate.setOperationFlag}, false, false, #{processTemplate.remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dp_base.t_dp_base_process_template SET process_info = #{processTemplateInfo}, process_check_code = NULL, process_parameter = NULL WHERE process_code = #{processCode} AND process_state = false AND delete_flag = false

UPDATE dp_base.t_dp_base_process_template SET process_check_code = #{processCheckCode}, coupling_table_codes = #{couplingTableCodes}, coupling_field_codes = #{couplingFieldCodes}, process_parameter = #{processParameter} WHERE process_code = #{processCode} AND process_state = false AND process_check_code IS NULL AND delete_flag = false

UPDATE dp_base.t_dp_base_process_template SET process_state = CASE WHEN process_state = true THEN false WHEN process_state = false THEN true END, over_started = true WHERE delete_flag = false AND process_code = #{processCode} AND process_check_code IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dp_base.t_dp_base_process_template WHERE delete_flag = false AND process_code = #{processCode} AND over_started = false
mapper.select: SELECT id, process_code, process_name, owned_enterprise_code, table_code, process_info, set_operation_flag, process_check_code, process_parameter, process_state, process_bubble_name, over_started, remark, update_time, create_time, delete_flag, coupling_table_codes, coupling_field_codes FROM dp_base.t_dp_base_process_template WHERE delete_flag = false

SELECT id, process_code, process_name, owned_enterprise_code, table_code, process_info, set_operation_flag, process_check_code, process_parameter, process_state, over_started, remark, update_time, create_time, delete_flag, coupling_table_codes, coupling_field_codes FROM dp_base.t_dp_base_process_template WHERE delete_flag = false and process_info like #{node}
UNION SELECT id, process_code, process_name, owned_enterprise_code, table_code, process_info, set_operation_flag, process_check_code, process_parameter, process_state, over_started, remark, update_time, create_time, delete_flag, coupling_table_codes, coupling_field_codes FROM dp_base.t_dp_base_process_template WHERE delete_flag = false AND process_info LIKE #{n}
